name: zsh extras
description: fzf-tab completion, fzf key bindings, a per-project zsh history that survives rebuilds, eza aliases, zoxide and starship, appended to the remote user's ~/.zshrc.

fzfKeybindings.description: Enable fzf key bindings (Ctrl-R, Ctrl-T, Alt-C)

persistHistory.description: Keep the zsh history (and the zoxide database) in a per-devcontainer volume

ezaAliases.description: Alias ls, l, ll, la, lt to eza (if installed)

ezaIcons.description: Show icons in the eza aliases (needs a Nerd Font)

starship.description: Use the starship prompt instead of the oh-my-zsh theme, if installed (feature-creep default config unless ~/.config/starship.toml exists)
